The final novelty referee capped the package at subfield (score ceiling 7.3), below the field floor (7.4); the independent validity consult confirmed this scope requires a material expansion to proceed. tldr: Outcome records can be scarce even when treatment doses are recorded widely. For the ordinary causal average derivative, dose-only observations inform an unknown distribution whose score is singular at both endpoints. This note proves the exact fixed-count joint minimax accuracy surface, including the critical boundary logarithm, with an explicit boundary-safe data-only projection estimator and a same-class all-procedure converse. It also gives the exact dose-registry growth needed for oracle accuracy and necessary-and-sufficient conditions for strict improvement over labeled-only estimation.
gap: Regular semisupervised theory does not determine the ordinary derivative risk when the outcome-noise score has infinite second moment. The credited exact-density boundary result does not determine the cost of learning the density multiplier.
fill: A joint expected-risk construction and legal two-prior experiments determine the accuracy surface, its critical logarithms, and the auxiliary-information thresholds without an assumed mixed rate.
